# Exercise - Block randomization

A trial compares treatments `A` and `B` with equal allocation.

In the package `blockrand`, the argument `block.sizes` is specified per treatment arm. In a two-arm trial, `block.sizes = 2` therefore corresponds to an actual block size of 4.

## Exercise 1

Generate a randomization list for `n = 24` patients using `blockrand::blockrand()` with actual block size 4. Compute the cumulative difference between the numbers in arms `A` and `B` after each patient.


```{r}
set.seed(201)
br1 <- blockrand::blockrand(n = 24,
                             levels = c("A", "B"),
                             block.sizes = 2)

trt1 <- br1$treatment[1:24]
running.diff1 <- cumsum(trt1 == "A") - cumsum(trt1 == "B")

cbind(patient = 1:24,
      treatment = trt1,
      running_diff = running.diff1)

table(trt1)
abs(sum(trt1 == "A") - sum(trt1 == "B"))
```


## Exercise 2

Generate a second list for `n = 24` patients using actual block sizes 4 and 6. Compare the final imbalance and the running imbalance with the previous list.


```{r}
set.seed(202)
br2 <- blockrand::blockrand(n = 24,
                             levels = c("A", "B"),
                             block.sizes = c(2, 3))

trt2 <- br2$treatment[1:24]
running.diff2 <- cumsum(trt2 == "A") - cumsum(trt2 == "B")

table(trt2)
abs(sum(trt2 == "A") - sum(trt2 == "B"))

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(running.diff1, type = "s",
     xlab = "Patient order", ylab = "Running difference (A - B)",
     main = "Actual block size 4")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(running.diff2, type = "s",
     xlab = "Patient order", ylab = "Running difference (A - B)",
     main = "Actual block sizes 4 and 6")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

```

## Exercise 3

Suppose that sex is an important prognostic factor. Simulate a variable `sex` with levels `Female` and `Male` for the same 24 patients, and perform block randomization separately within each sex group. Display the treatment counts by sex.


```{r}
set.seed(203)
sex <- factor(sample(c("Female", "Male"), 24, replace = TRUE))

trt.strat <- character(24)
for (lev in levels(sex)) {
  idx <- which(sex == lev)
  br <- blockrand::blockrand(n = length(idx),
                             levels = c("A", "B"),
                             block.sizes = 2)
  trt.strat[idx] <- br$treatment[1:length(idx)]
}

table(trt.strat, sex)


```
